note: Max rank only. The simulator runs at level 60, and a talent tooltip shows rank 1 of the ability it grants -- see docs/class-implementation.md.

spells.name: Amplify Curse
spells.description: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Bane of Agony
spells.description: Afflicts the target with agony, causing 552 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Bane reaches its full duration. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Bane of Doom
spells.description: Afflicts the target with impending doom, causing 1,742 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Bane of Havoc
spells.description: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Banish
spells.description: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 30 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.

spells.name: Blood Pact
spells.description: Increases party members' Stamina by 54.

spells.name: Conflagrate
spells.description: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 251 to 313 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

spells.name: Consume Shadows
spells.description: The Voidwalker consumes nearby shadows to bolster its form, recovering 1,940 health over 10 sec. Cannot be used while in combat.

spells.name: Corruption
spells.description: Corrupts the target, causing 438 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

spells.name: Create Firestone
spells.description: Creates a Major Firestone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Fire, increasing your spell critical strike chance by 2% and the damage done by your Fire spells by up to 21.

spells.name: Create Healthstone
spells.description:
Creates a Major Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 1,440 health.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spells.name: Create Soulstone
spells.description:
Creates a Major Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 2,200 health and 2,800 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spells.name: Create Spellstone
spells.description:
Creates a Major Spellstone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Shadow, increasing your spell haste by 2% and the damage done by your Shadow spells by up to 21.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spells.name: Curse of Exhaustion
spells.description: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Curse of Recklessness
spells.description: Curses the target with recklessness, reducing the target's armor by 505 for 2 min. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Curse of the Elements
spells.description: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Magic resistances by 75 and increases Magic damage taken by 10%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Curse of Tongues
spells.description: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 60%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Curse of Weakness
spells.description: Physical damage caused by the target is reduced by 37 for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Death Coil
spells.description: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 460 Shadow damage. The caster gains 100% of the damage caused in health.

spells.name: Demon Armor
spells.description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 570, Shadow resistance by 15 and increases health regeneration by 15 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

spells.name: Demon Skin
spells.description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 120 and increases health regeneration by 5 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

spells.name: Demonic Sacrifice
spells.description:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hrs. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

spells.name: Detect Invisibility
spells.description: Allows the friendly target to detect greater invisibility for 10 min.

spells.name: Devour Magic
spells.description: Purges 1 harmful magic effect from a friend or 1 beneficial magic effect from an enemy. If an effect is devoured, the Felhunter will be healed for 618.

spells.name: Drain Life
spells.description: Transfers 51 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

spells.name: Drain Mana
spells.description: Transfers 139 Mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

spells.name: Drain Soul
spells.description: Drains the soul of the target, causing 420 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.

spells.name: Eye of Kilrogg
spells.description: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.

spells.name: Fear
spells.description: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

spells.name: Fel Domination
spells.description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.description: Surrounds the target in a shield of fire. Every strike against the target causes 13 Fire damage to the attacker. Lasts 3 min. Your pet cannot cast Fire Shield on itself.

spells.name: Firebolt
spells.description: Deals 42 to 48 Fire damage to a target.

spells.name: Health Funnel
spells.description: Gives 153 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels. Generates reduced threat.

spells.name: Hellfire
spells.description: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 210 Fire damage to himself and 210 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

spells.name: Howl of Terror
spells.description: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 15 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

spells.name: Immolate
spells.description: Burns the enemy for 158 Fire damage and then an additional 275 Fire damage over 15 sec.

spells.name: Incinerate
spells.description: Deals 201 to 233 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

spells.name: Inferno
spells.description: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 5 min. Once control is lost, the Infernal must be Subjugated to maintain control. Can only be used outdoors.

spells.name: Lash of Pain
spells.description: An instant attack that lashes the target, causing 50 Shadow damage.

spells.name: Lesser Invisibility
spells.description: Gives your summoned demon Lesser Invisibility for up to 5 min. This spell can only be used out of combat.

spells.name: Life Tap
spells.description: Converts 424 health into 424 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount of Mana converted. Mana gained is increased by your Spirit.

spells.name: Paranoia
spells.description: Increases the stealth detection of all party members within 30 yds of the Felhunter as if they were 6 levels higher.

spells.name: Phase Shift
spells.description: Shifts the imp out of phase with the world, making it unattackable unless it attacks.

spells.name: Rain of Fire
spells.description: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 884 Fire damage over 8 sec.

spells.name: Ritual of Doom
spells.description: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

spells.name: Ritual of Summoning
spells.description: Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

spells.name: Sacrifice
spells.description: Sacrifices the Voidwalker, giving its owner a shield that will absorb 1,930 damage for 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage.

spells.name: Searing Pain
spells.description: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 107 to 125 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.

spells.name: Seduction
spells.description: Seduces the target, preventing all actions for up to 15 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Only works against Humanoids.

spells.name: Sense Demons
spells.description: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.

spells.name: Shadow Bolt
spells.description: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 253 to 283 Shadow damage.

spells.name: Shadow Ward
spells.description: Absorbs 920 shadow damage. Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Shadowburn
spells.description: Instantly blasts the target for 258 to 288 Shadow damage. If the target dies within 8 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

spells.name: Siphon Life
spells.description: Transfers 41 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Soothing Kiss
spells.description: Soothes the target, increasing the chance that it will attack something else. More effective than Soothing Kiss (Rank 3).

spells.name: Soul Fire
spells.description: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 390 to 486 Fire damage.

spells.name: Soul Link
spells.description: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

spells.name: Spell Lock
spells.description: Silences the enemy for 3 sec. If used on a casting target, it will counter the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 8 sec.

spells.name: Subjugate Demon
spells.description: Subjugates the target demon, up to level 64, forcing it to do your bidding. While subjugated, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 40% and its casting speed is slowed by 30%. Lasts up to 5 min. If you repeatedly subjugate the same demon, it will become more difficult to control with each attempt.

spells.name: Suffering
spells.description: Taunts all enemies within 10 yards, increasing the chance that they will attack the Voidwalker. More effective than Suffering (Rank 3).

spells.name: Summon Felhunter
spells.description: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

spells.name: Summon Imp
spells.description: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

spells.name: Summon Incubus
spells.description: Summons an Incubus under the command of the Warlock.

spells.name: Summon Succubus
spells.description: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

spells.name: Summon Voidwalker
spells.description: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

spells.name: Tainted Blood
spells.description: Taints the Felhunter's blood for 1 min. When the Felhunter is hit with a melee attack, the attacker will lose 40 melee attack power for 10 sec. Stacks up to 5 times on a single target.

spells.name: Torment
spells.description: Taunts the creature, increasing the chance that it will attack the Voidwalker. More effective than Torment (Rank 5).

spells.name: Unending Breath
spells.description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

spells.name: Wrack
spells.description: Tears the target apart from within, dealing 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10%. Lasts 6 sec.
